newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France signs deal with second union.
newsitem.headline: Air France signs deal with second union.

text.p: Air France said on Thursday that a second union representing pilots had signed an accord with the company on a two-tier wage scale, signalling a division in the pilots' ranks in the midst of a strike.

The national flag-carrier said in a statement that the SNOMAC union had signed the accord reached on Tuesday with the SPAC union. A spokesman for the carrier could not say what percentage of the pilots are represented by the SNOMAC union.
Four other unions have refused to sign the accord and called a strike, now in its third day.
Air France has proposed a lower wage scale for new hires to reduce its wage costs and bring them in line with those of its competitors.
The airline said that it has been able to assure 65 percent of its scheduled flights despite the strike and almost all of its long-haul flights.
